Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Money, work & business

trade verb

exchange one thing for another

also swap, exchange, barter, trade places, swap places, exchange prisoners

classical

Hor. C. 3.1.47–48: cūr valle permūtem Sabīnā dīvitiās operōsiōrēs?

permūtō, permūtāre, permūtāvī, permūtātum

verb, first conjugation

exchange, swap (one thing for another)

One of the two things goes in the ablative; the context shows which is given and which received (Lewis & Short s.v. mūtō).

Other words

  • mūtō, mūtāre, mūtāvī, mūtātum — exchange, barter

    verb, first conjugation · also used · classical · Sall. J. 18.9: mūtāre rēs inter sē īnstituerant; Hor. S. 2.7.109–110

    Its everyday sense is “change”; of goods, to barter (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • cūr valle permūtem Sabīnā dīvitiās operōsiōrēs?

    why should I trade my Sabine valley for riches that are more trouble?Hor. C. 3.1.47–48

  • sub noctem quī puer ūvam furtīvā mūtat strigilī

    the slave boy who at nightfall swaps a stolen strigil for a bunch of grapesHor. S. 2.7.109–110

  • captīvōs inter sē permūtāre

    to exchange prisonersTraupman 311

See also change money, business.
